ask.text:
(Name) has worked every day of (his/her) life, from before dawn to after dark, and has never once taken a day off. (He/She) is proud of it. But this morning (he/she) sits down on (his/her) doorstep and doesn't get up, and when people ask, (he/she) says, quite calmly, "I think I'd like to stop now."
Nobody knows what to do. Some think (name) should be encouraged back to work, gently, because it's what (he/she) loves. Others think (he/she) has earned the rest.
What should the village do?

c1o1.text: (Name) sits in the sun for a week, then a month. To everyone's surprise, (he/she) doesn't go back. (He/She) has worked enough, (he/she) says, and the love of it has gone, the way a fire goes out when it has burned everything it needed to. (He/She) spends (his/her) days talking to the children and feeding the birds, and is, quite clearly, happy.

c1o2.text: (Name) has never been able to sit still. For the first few days (he/she) fidgets, and gets up, and sits down, and complains. But slowly, the sun and the quiet do their work, and (name) learns, at last, how to rest. "I should have tried this sixty years ago," (he/she) says, and goes back to work a week later, but takes the afternoons off.

c1.text: The village brings (name) a soft mat and a cup of something warm, and leaves (him/her) alone on (his/her) doorstep in the sun...

c2o1.text: (Name) sits on (his/her) doorstep and tells everyone who passes what they're doing wrong, and is, infuriatingly, right every time. Within a month, three of the young people have improved so much they're unrecognisable. (Name) takes all the credit, and deserves it.

c2o2.text: Teaching suits (name) so well that within a month (he/she) looks years younger. The tiredness goes out of (his/her) face, and the lines soften, and people keep saying (he/she) looks like (he/she) did twenty years ago. "Stopping work," (name) says, "is the best thing that ever happened to me."

c2.text: "Teach us," says one of the young ones. "Just sit there and tell us what we're doing wrong." (Name)'s eyes light up...
